name: OmniCloud
description: One workspace for every cloud drive you own

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (connected accounts with their encrypted logins, the file list and settings) and the secret keys.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OmniCloud web app and API, published on host as 6154

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open OmniCloud at, like http://192.168.1.20:6154. Change localhost to your server IP. The Google, OneDrive, Dropbox and Yandex sign-in callbacks are made from it (PUBLIC_URL/api/accounts/google/callback and so on).
